title: Riot Squad BAR EDTN Strawberry Peach Razz No Ice 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Riot Squad’s Bar Edition collection introduces Strawberry Peach Razz flavour, combining the soft, sweet flavour of classic Strawberry with the rich, juicy sweetness of Peach and a touch of tangy Raspberry in a convenient 10ml bottle for use with refillable vape kits. This e-liquid is part of a unique Riot Squad collection designed to emulate the intense flavours found in many disposable vapes. The e-liquid is available in nicotine strengths of 5mg, 10mg, and 20mg, catering to various preferences and vaping needs. Its 60% PG / 40% VG ratio ensures a harmonious balance between throat hit and vapour production, making it a fitting choice for those who prefer mouth-to-lung (MTL) vaping with low-powered kits that use high-resistance coils, such as pod kits and starter kits and some types of refillable disposable vapes. Riot Squad Bar Edition e-liquids contain a Nicotine Salt formulation, which provides a smoother throat hit compared to traditional freebase nicotine and allows for higher nicotine strengths. This makes the Strawberry Raspberry Cherry flavour e-liquid a comfortable one for everyday vaping and a great pick for newer adult vapers, particularly former heavy smokers. Manufactured in the UK, this e-liquid adheres to Riot Squad’s high standards of production and safety. The tamper-evident seal and made-in-the-UK assurance are testaments to Riot Squad's dedication to consumer safety and product reliability, ensuring that vapers receive a premium product every time.
